title: Degree5 Ranked Lll
objective: Generalize the exact connected ranked-LLL primitive graph for the authenticated quintic honesty collector: degree-5 ideal preparation, integer rank, full-rank selection, and FLATTER, with degree-4 regression and PARI/dynamic/native controls

handoff.summary: The connected ranked-preparation graph now accepts degree five, computes PARI's initial modular rank, uses the pinned degree-five selector thresholds, and reproduces PARI's exact LLL transform, prepared ideal, embedding product, QR reduction, and enumeration boundary for all six authenticated honesty ideals across CPython, JavaScript, and native GMP. A pristine PARI-built degree-four control preserves the established path.
risks: General degree-five FLATTER remains deliberately unsupported because it needs a translated 3x3 recursive LLL leaf. All six authenticated quintic collector inputs have PARI useflatter=0, so that branch is not part of this exact connected path.
next_steps: Integrate this commit with the quintic honesty collector exporter and rerun its six fresh probes; any remaining mismatch is downstream of ranked preparation.
Translate the 3x3 FLATTER leaf before claiming arbitrary degree-five ranked LLL outside the authenticated no-FLATTER corridor.
